name: scs-v2-sealed-confirmation-acquisition
title: SCS v2 sealed confirmation acquisition
description: Discover 3-5 previously unexposed official SCS cruises from metadata and deployment geometry only, then acquire their raw archives as opaque sealed bytes with reproducible provenance and independent verification.
creator: Ruichen Zhou
notes: Stage A commit 948519b, Stage A.1 commit b6de3a6, Stage A.2 commit 7359f47/run 20260805T221441Z, and Stage B.0 execution-code commit c3871f54f8041fcb2d3ae18cd124d3b5223c118f/readiness run 20260805T224911Z are retained. Authorized Stage B run 20260805T230449Z acquired the immutable ordered set EQT20210702, EQT190012, EQT180002, TN352 through the user-selected 2082/HK-DC proxy: 768 objects and exactly 9,626,893,507 bytes. Independent verification passed with 768/768 Last-Modified closures and 768/768 reopened SHA256 checks. The preceding run 20260805T225949Z is retained as failed_unsealed with one pre-body proxy failure, zero completed objects and zero completed bytes. The authoritative acquisition remains sealed_unprocessed with content_parsed=false, confirmation_role_eligible=false, stage_c_authorized=false and access_allowed=false. Stage C remains a separate unapproved decision gate.
